name: metabase-jala
description: Connect Codex and Claude Code to JALA's shared Metabase instance through its built-in MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Use JALA Metabase content and query tools.
interface.longDescription: Connect to JALA's shared Metabase instance through its built-in MCP server. OAuth calls run as the signed-in Metabase user and follow that user's permissions and the instance's MCP tool access settings. The plugin supports saved content and queries, including SQL where authorized; SQL may overwrite or delete data or content if the database role permits it. User, group, membership, and permission administration are outside its supported scope.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use JALA Metabase to work with dashboards, questions, collections, and authorized queries.
